newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Robbers in police garb take Hanoi zoo's cash.
newsitem.headline: Robbers in police garb take Hanoi zoo's cash.

text.p: Two men posing as police officers flagged down a car in Hanoi on New Year's Eve, handcuffed its driver and passenger and snatched a bag of cash belonging to the city zoo, the Thanh Nien newspaper reported on Tuesday.
The police declined to comment on the report, which said the robbers were armed with guns and wore police uniforms.
One of the men even faked a call to "headquarters" on a mobile phone to request a car to come and arrest the bewildered zoo employees.
Thanh Nien said they made off with 80 million dong ($7,160), about 26 times the annual per capita income in Vietnam.
